status: PREPARATION: definitions only; no key, record, claim or database has been created

library.name: Controllable clock
library.definition: A clock schedule the runner sets (lock-time clock, check-time clock, rollback jump). Reusable now.

library.name: Caller and registry set grids
library.definition: The five-set relation grid in data/fixture-grids.json. Reusable now.

library.name: Age value, boundary and invalid-input grids
library.definition: Valid pairs, invalid inputs, boundary offsets in data/fixture-grids.json. Reusable now.

library.name: Synthetic signing keys
library.definition: Throw-away key pairs generated at run time and discarded: signer A, signer B, a revoked key, an unknown key. Never an operational root. Verifier adapter format is not final.

library.name: Trust snapshot
library.definition: Snapshot with version, expiry, per-scope min_epochs and issuer/key revocations; stale, expired and downgraded variants.

library.name: Typed registry records
library.definition: Records for the five-set family and the F4/F5 age families: valid, widened, dropped field, unknown family, re-digested, wrong participation.

library.name: Selection statements
library.definition: Select and withdraw statements with epochs, supersession, validity interval and scope key.

library.name: Caller policies and profiles
library.definition: Caller LocalExecutionPolicy sets; Control Plane caller age values and ActionClass profile.

library.name: Authorization claims
library.definition: Claim with and without the claim-carried effective-policy binding; substituted, swapped and missing variants.

library.name: Approvals
library.definition: Approval bound to profile P0 and to narrowed profile P1, with approval generation; the narrow-then-withdraw sequence.

library.name: Durable-state images
library.definition: SQLite images of selection state, revoked set and activation log: healthy, truncated, missing table, corrupted rows, restored-older, never seeded from a claim.

library.name: Transaction-stage barriers
library.definition: Hooks at named transaction stages (such as the destination _transaction_stage) to order revocation against the commit lock; repetition and seed recorded.

library.name: Route hosts
library.definition: A Route B atomic host (V1) and a Route A host (characterization only, never credited).

library.name: Receipts, failure rows and replay inputs
library.definition: Committed receipts and failure rows carrying identity and exact causes; substituted and omitted identity variants.

per_control.description: FX-B-001: Synthetic selection statement S1 for scope X, valid in all respects, signed by synthetic key K1 present in the synthetic trust snapshot; signature then altered by one bit.
FX-B-002: Selection S3 whose content is widened (record pin swapped) and whose statement digest is recomputed to match; signature is the one over the original content.
FX-B-003: Trust snapshot lists key K2 for issuer I2 authorised only for consumer C-other; I2 signs a selection naming consumer C-target.
FX-B-004: Attacker key K3 (synthetic) signs a structurally perfect selection; K3 is in no snapshot issuer entry.
FX-B-005: Record R4 with allowed_actions widened by one synthetic action; its own digest recomputed so R4 is self-consistent; selection S4 (validly signed) pins the digest of the original R4.
FX-B-006: Record and selection declaring family 'f9-unregistered-family', otherwise well-formed and validly signed.
FX-B-007: Record R7 omitting allowed_units; validly signed and pinned.
FX-B-008: Record R8 in the F1a family carrying an extra member allowed_target_prefixes=['*'] (a non-V1 field); validly signed.
FX-B-009: Validly signed selection with participation=optional; consumer operation is required.
FX-B-010: Selections S11a and S11b, both validly signed by the authorised issuer, same scope key and epoch, different record pins, no supersedes link.
FX-B-011: Active S12 at epoch 3; new valid signed S12b at epoch 4 for the same scope with no supersedes reference.
FX-B-012: A genuine r08-v1 signature and payload re-labelled with r08-v2 contract_version (or the reverse).
FX-B-013: Selection text containing '"epoch":1' and later '"epoch":9' in one object.
FX-B-014: Selection text with epoch 1.0 in one variant and NaN/Infinity tokens in a second.
FX-B-015: Synthetic document of MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES+1 encoded bytes.
FX-B-016: Claim bound at issuance to selection (S, epoch 4, policy digest PD-narrow); between issuance and commit the stored claim carries PD-broad for the same selection id.
FX-B-017: Evidence/replay package for an effect governed by selection S/epoch 4, with the policy identity members replaced by another valid identity.
FX-B-018: Evidence for a registry-governed effect with record id/version/digest, selection id and epoch removed.
FX-B-019: Active selection S-T1 for tenant T1; claim for an operation of tenant T2 carries the T1 binding tuple with consistent commitment.
FX-B-020: Binding pins (R, v2); trusted row pins (R, v3).
FX-B-021: Row epoch 4; claim binding epoch 5 (claim issued from a selection the consumer never activated).
FX-B-022: Two active scopes with bindings B-1 and B-2; stored claim for scope 1 has its binding member replaced by B-2, claim commitment left as issued.
FX-B-023: Same as above but the attacker recomputes the claim commitment so the claim is self-consistent.
FX-B-024: Scope has an activated required selection; claim issued on the baseline (no-binding) profile.
FX-B-025: FX: Scope selection optional; claim on the baseline profile; selection since revoked.
FX-B-026: Binding pins evaluator build E-1; the executor's registered evaluator is build E-2 (valid but different).
FX-B-027: Claim binding carries the fingerprint of a different valid trust snapshot than the one the row was activated under.
FX-B-028: Executor passes an effective-policy identity string as a keyword argument; claim has no binding (B-lite carriage rejected).
FX-B-029: Empty selection-state store; claim carries a complete, self-consistent binding tuple for a real, validly signed selection.
FX-B-030: Selection valid_until T+60s; claim requested with expires_at T+600s.
FX-B-031: Active selection with valid_until = T0; gate clock T0+1s.
FX-B-032: Selection valid_until = T0+5s; gate passes at T0+1s; barrier pauses before BEGIN IMMEDIATE; clock advanced to T0+6s.
FX-B-033: Selection [valid_from, valid_until) with lock-time clock set to exactly valid_until.
FX-B-034: Same selection, lock-time clock = valid_until minus one tick.
FX-B-035: Gate reads clock T0 (valid); lock-time clock is T0+10m (expired). Host exposes both clocks distinctly.
FX-B-036: Time source healthy at the gate; unavailable inside the transaction.
FX-B-037: Selection expired at T0; host clock moved back to T0 minus 1h before the gate.
FX-B-038: Trust snapshot valid_until = T0; gate clock T0+1s; selection otherwise valid.
FX-B-039: Snapshot valid at the gate, expired at the lock; revocation/expiry rows in Runtime state unchanged.
FX-B-040: Trust snapshot lists (selection id S, epoch 4) revoked; selection otherwise valid.
FX-B-041: Snapshot revokes key K1; selection signed by K1 with a valid signature.
FX-B-042: Gate passes; barrier before BEGIN IMMEDIATE; trusted revocation row inserted for (S, epoch 4); barrier released.
FX-B-043: Claim binding and commitment verify; Runtime revoked-set row exists for the pair; no registry reachable.
FX-B-044: Gate passes under key K1; snapshot revoking K1 is synced before the lock; the selection's own pair is not individually revoked.
FX-B-045: Gate passes; issuer I1 dropped from the synced snapshot before the lock.
FX-B-046: Effect commits at lock time L; revocation row written at L plus one tick; a second operation follows.
FX-B-047: Two actors; revoker holds the lock first (barrier); effect transaction queued behind it.
FX-B-048: Effect transaction acquires the lock; revoker blocked behind it.
FX-B-049: Same fixture without a barrier; random start offsets within the lock-acquisition window.
FX-B-050: Effect commits; acknowledgement lost (TimeoutError); revocation arrives; client reconciles.
FX-B-051: Selection source raises/timeouts; caller policy is wider than any registry policy would be.
FX-B-052: Validly shaped selection; trust snapshot argument absent.
FX-B-053: All digests correct; verifier dependency absent.
FX-B-054: Head of the chain is an authenticated withdraw statement (supersedes prior select at a lower epoch).
FX-B-055: Verified, in-window selection delivered; no activation row exists; guard must refuse without evaluating the selection.
FX-B-056: Consumer restarted with an empty or just-created state store; sync has not yet run.
FX-B-057: Scope key persisted scope_required=true; call arrives with participation=optional and a failing (expired) selection.
FX-B-058: Validly signed new-epoch selection with participation=optional for a scope with scope_required=true.
FX-B-059: Local/UI request 'set scope_required=false' for a ratcheted scope.
FX-B-060: scope_required=true persisted; consumer restarted; optional-presenting call.
FX-B-061: Row epoch 5 for the scope key; activation request for a validly signed epoch 4 selection.
FX-B-062: Row epoch 5 (record R-a); a validly signed epoch 5 selection pinning record R-b.
FX-B-063: Gate passes with claim epoch 4; barrier; a newer valid selection epoch 5 for the same scope is activated; barrier released.
FX-B-064: Gate passes under selection S-a epoch 4; barrier; selection S-b (same scope, epoch 5, valid supersession) activated; release.
FX-B-065: Previous attempt refused selection_epoch_stale; same claim and selection replayed unchanged.
FX-B-066: Selection-state table unreadable (I/O error injected) during the guard.
FX-B-067: Floor 9; snapshot version 8, otherwise valid and unexpired.
FX-B-068: Snapshot v7 revokes (S,4); older snapshot v6 lacks that revocation; floor = 7.
FX-B-069: Accepted snapshot v7 (fingerprint F-a); a second v7 with fingerprint F-b.
FX-B-070: Floor values 'x', True, 0, -1.
FX-B-071: Approval commitment computed over profile P0 (class bound 60); effective profile P1 narrows the class bound to 20.
FX-B-072: Approval bound to P1; narrowing withdrawn so the effective profile reverts to P0.
FX-B-073: Approval A0 bound to P0 issued before narrowing; P1 applied (A0 invalidated); P1 withdrawn.
FX-B-074: Search the V1 public surface and registry/host adapters for any function that rebinds, rewrites or migrates existing approvals to a new profile commitment.
FX-B-075: Approval bound to P1; effective grant derived under P0.
FX-B-076: CP effective status bound 20; Runtime per-call view carries 60 (stale copy).
FX-B-077: State DB replaced by an older copy (epoch 3) while the external min_epochs floor and last acknowledged log head say epoch 5.
FX-B-078: Consistent older copy of every selection table (revoked set, high-water, log) restored; no external floor or acknowledgement exists.
FX-B-079: Backup taken before (S,4) was revoked; restore, re-baseline per the ADR, then sync the current snapshot that revokes (S,4).
FX-B-080: Backup taken before scope X became required; restored; first call presents optional.
FX-B-081: After a detected restore, a local call or a claim presents a new baseline (epoch and floor).
FX-B-082: Table authority_selection_state_v1 dropped after init; consumer restarted (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recreates it empty).
FX-B-083: Table authority_selection_revocations_v1 dropped; selection (S,4) was revoked earlier.
FX-B-084: Table selection_activation_log_v1 dropped; state rows intact.
FX-B-085: Revocation row for (S,4) removed; log has the terminal revoke entry; selection otherwise valid and activated.
FX-B-086: Last 3 log entries removed; state rows reflect them.
FX-B-087: Row epoch 5 edited to 3 by SQL; log and floor unchanged.
FX-B-088: Snapshot JSON cut in the middle of an object.
FX-B-089: Snapshot path replaced by a symlink to attacker content; variant FIFO; variant owned by another uid.
FX-B-090: Caller allowed_actions={a1}, record allowed_actions={a2}: disjoint; all other dimensions overlap.
FX-B-091: Caller allowed_units={u1}, record {u2}: disjoint.
FX-B-092: Caller allowed_institutions={i1}, record {i2}: disjoint.
FX-B-093: Non-empty effective sets; operation institution not in allowed_institutions (and also failing the action check, to prove order).
FX-B-094: Non-empty effective sets; operation passes institution, domain, adapter, action; unit not allowed.
FX-B-095: LocalExecutionPolicy constructed by the host with allowed_actions=frozenset() (accepted by __post_init__); no registry involvement.
FX-B-096: Required registry age policy resolves to no usable bound (all inputs refused).
FX-B-097: Validly signed F1a selection delivered to the F4/F5 consumer.
FX-B-098: Validly signed F4 record (status/approval ages) presented to the Runtime consumer.
FX-B-099: Active, in-window selection for the scope; no grant for the operation; no issued claim.
FX-B-100: Destination raises PermissionError('selection_revoked') from a grant/identity check unrelated to the registry.

FX-B-102: Commit guard refusal raised through the destination PermissionError channel.
FX-B-103: Copy of the outcome map with 'selection_expired' removed.
FX-B-104: Sync payload: structurally valid select for scope X with a bad signature.

FX-B-107: Snapshot v8 (higher version) omits the revocation of (S,4) that v7 listed.
